description: This PHP source file defines the Composer\Autoload\ClassLoader class, which implements a PSR-0, PSR-4, and classmap-based autoloader for PHP projects. It includes methods for registering class prefixes, directories, class maps, and for loading class files on demand.

classes.name: ClassLoader
classes.description: Implements a versatile autoloader supporting PSR-0, PSR-4, and classmap standards.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ClassLoader instance with an optional vendor directory.

methods.name: getPrefixes
methods.description: Returns all registered PSR-0 prefixes.

methods.name: getPrefixesPsr4
methods.description: Returns all registered PSR-4 namespaces and directories.

methods.name: getFallbackDirs
methods.description: Returns fallback directories for PSR-0.

methods.name: getFallbackDirsPsr4
methods.description: Returns fallback directories for PSR-4.

methods.name: getClassMap
methods.description: Returns the class-to-file map.

methods.name: addClassMap
methods.description: Merges provided class map with existing class map.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers PSR-0 directories for a specific prefix.

methods.name: addPsr4
methods.description: Registers PSR-4 directories for a specific namespace.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Replaces PSR-0 prefixes for a given prefix.

methods.name: setPsr4
methods.description: Replaces PSR-4 directories for a namespace.

methods.name: setUseIncludePath
methods.description: Enables or disables searching the include path.

methods.name: getUseIncludePath
methods.description: Checks if include path searching is enabled.

methods.name: setClassMapAuthoritative
methods.description: Sets whether class map is authoritative for class loading.

methods.name: isClassMapAuthoritative
methods.description: Checks if class map is set as authoritative.

methods.name: setApcuPrefix
methods.description: Sets the APCu cache prefix if extension and configuration are enabled.

methods.name: getApcuPrefix
methods.description: Returns the APCu cache prefix or null if not enabled.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the autoloader with SPL.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the autoloader from SPL.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class by its name, including its file.

methods.name: findFile
methods.description: Finds the file path for a given class name.

methods.name: getRegisteredLoaders
methods.description: Returns all registered autoloaders.

methods.name: findFileWithExtension
methods.description: Finds a class file with a specific extension (.php, .hh).

methods.name: initializeIncludeClosure
methods.description: Initializes the static include closure to scope included files.
